GHA.note: The notice concerns digital credit licensing, not payment or e-money providers.

facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana's Notice BG/GOV/SEC/2026/36 of 2026-10-06 says the Directive for Digital Credit Service Providers in Ghana (September 2025) is in force and that 20 named loan apps operate in contravention of it, violating consumer protection and customer data privacy.
